skill.displayName: AI Breast Expansion – Natural Body Proportion Editing for Photos Online – API-powered
skill.summary: Edit body proportions in photos using AI — adjust breast size via text prompt, with optional image input

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-breast-expansion-openapi-skill.
- Enables AI-powered editing of photographic body proportions; adjust breast size via text prompt.
- Supports optional image upload and batch output (up to 16 results at once).
- Requires a WeShop API key (HTTPS only; never share your key outside the official domain).
- Includes endpoints for starting jobs, polling run status, and uploading images.
